test_description: unauthenticated requests cannot list reports
account validation rejects incomplete registration
resident registration creates a session without leaking password
duplicate accounts are rejected
incorrect password does not authenticate
category, description and location are validated on server
invalid GPS coordinates are rejected
non-image data cannot be uploaded as a photo
submission produces a reference and an initial timeline event
retrying a submission does not create a duplicate
another resident cannot read a report or its photo
residents cannot update status
staff can sign in and anonymous identity is withheld
staff update appears in resident timeline
invalid and redundant status updates are rejected
resolved status preserves earlier history
photo storage and authorized retrieval work
cross-site mutation attempts are rejected
reports and history survive a server restart
logout invalidates the server session
A resident can register through the interface and reach the dashboard.
Required fields show inline errors and the first invalid field receives focus.
Review-to-edit retains form data and shows the revised location.
Submission confirms a reference and opens the resident timeline.
Anonymous reporter name and mobile are hidden in staff detail.
A staff update appears on the resident timeline after refresh.
Resolution preserves all three timeline entries.
Search and status filters return the matching report or an empty state.
390px mobile detail layout has no horizontal overflow.
GPS denial leaves manual location entry available.
Network failure keeps the report draft available for correction and retry.
No uncaught browser JavaScript errors during the tested flow.
Sign-out returns to sign-in and permits resident-to-staff switching in the same browser.
